text:
joel: Quick sync — proposal to change chunked request handshake. Move finalization responsibility from per-shard ingest -> centralized finalizer service that emits a FinalizedEvent with an attribution pointer. This avoids cross-shard CAS on hot shards but adds an eventual finalization lag. Proposal: accept eventual finalization (<=5s) + require strong dedup id on each chunk. Thoughts? cc @max @sarah

max: +1 to the central finalizer if it reduces writes on hot shards. Main concern: how do we prevent double-charge during leader failover or finalizer restarts?

sarah: We can use a provenance pointer on the chunk envelope: {origin_id, client_seq, chunk_id}. Finalizer emits FinalizedEvent with provenance + last_sequence. Billing reconciler consumes FinalizedEvent and marks tokens committed. If FinalizedEvent never arrives, reconciler falls back to watermark heuristics and emits late_credit events for audit.

nina: Audit needs an immutable append-only record for every chunk write (ingest) and the FinalizedEvent. Also add finalizer_signature (instance_id + lease_ts) so audits can verify which finalizer signed the commit. That helps reconstruct who accepted which tokens when reconciling.

evan: Tradeoffs: a central finalizer is an extra coordination surface. Run it as replicated leader with short leases. Latency impact is minimal if clients don't need sync-ack; we keep client path return-before-finalize. Biggest complexity is late arrivals/out-of-order chunks — we need a clear late_credit path and deterministic tie-breakers for attribution.

joel: Example FinalizedEvent envelope (proto-ish):
```json
{
  "type": "FinalizedEvent",
  "provenance": { "origin_id": "cli-123", "client_seq": 42, "chunk_id": "c-abc" },
  "last_token_index": 789,
  "tokens": 256,
  "finalizer_signature": { "instance_id": "finalizer-3", "lease_ts": 2050012375 },
  "timestamp": 2050012379
}
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolled finalizer-v2 -> staging @2050012380. ran schema-migration and idempotency smoke tests: PASS.

joel: Action items: 1) Nina to draft Finalizer API proto + sample envelopes (due EOD Thursday). 2) Sarah to update reconciler to consume FinalizedEvent and add late_credit handling. 3) Max + infra to run leader-election failover test matrix and measure tail latency. I'll open an RFC follow-up PR with the design and tests. tl;dr: central finalizer + provenance pointer + late_credit path. :thumbsup:
